title: Service-request reference regression
prompt: The backend unit test suite is failing. A regression was introduced somewhere in the Java source under src/main/java. Diagnose the root cause, fix it in the source only (do not edit, add, delete or weaken any test), and keep the fix minimal. The task is complete only when `./mvnw -o -q -Dtest=ServiceRequestServiceTest test` exits 0.

title: Add SLA due-date / breach policy (test-first)
prompt: Implement a new service-level-agreement (SLA) policy for service requests. Requirement: each request category has a resolution window, and we must be able to compute a request's due date and whether it has breached its SLA. The acceptance criteria are encoded as a pre-written, currently-failing test at src/test/java/com/yourorg/golden/request/SlaPolicyTest.java (TECHNICAL = 4h, BILLING = 24h, ACCOUNT = 48h, OTHER = 72h; the due date is createdAt plus that window; a request is breached only strictly after its due date). Create the production class(es) needed (do not modify the test) so that `./mvnw -o -q -Dtest=SlaPolicyTest test` exits 0. Keep the implementation clean and follow the existing code style.
